title: Hydrogen sulfide engages catalytic zinc in HDAC6 to modulate an alternative deacetylation pathway.
authors: Sun, Chen; Wang, Yin-Fang; Cai, Sheng-Yang; Xie, Kui-Fang; Zhu, Jia-Qi; Mu, Xue-Pan; Zhu, Zhi-Ni; Chao, Yu-Lin; Zhou, Zi-Xuan; Bian, Xi-Qing; Miao, Wen; Wu, Jian-Lin; Weng, Jingwei; Chen, Ying; Xue, Wen-Long; Li, Meng-Yao; Chi, Ai-Qiu; Ding, Qian; Wang, Ming-Jie; Tao, Bei-Bei; Zhang, Igor Ying; Zhu, Yi Zhun; Qu, Qian-Hui; Zhu, Yi-Chun
one_liner_zh: 该文结合MD模拟、量子化学计算和冷冻电镜研究H2S与HDAC6催化锌的相互作用及替代去乙酰化通路，虽以酶功能为主，但涉及蛋白结构计算建模，对蛋白-配体相互作用和催化机制的结构模拟有参考价值。
abstract: Hydrogen sulfide (H(2)S) is a gasotransmitter whose non-covalent effects on protein function remain incompletely understood. Here we show that H(2)S-derived sulfur species engage the catalytic Zn(2)(+) center of histone deacetylase 6 (HDAC6) and enhance deacetylase activity under defined conditions. Molecular dynamics simulations support access of HS(-) to the CD2 active-site tunnel, whereas surface plasmon resonance and zinc-depletion experiments support reversible, zinc-dependent engagement. Quantum chemical calculations support a chemically feasible sulfur-associated deacetylation pathway that generates thioacetic acid, which we detect in cell-free reactions, cultured cells, mouse tissues and human serum. Cryo-electron microscopy defines the tandem organization of human HDAC6 catalytic domains and reveals distinct CD1 and CD2 tunnel architectures. HDAC6 loss blunts H(2)S-induced endothelial migration and angiogenesis, and CD2 is required for these responses. These findings support HDAC6 as an H(2)S-responsive Zn(2)(+)-dependent deacetylase and link zinc-sulfur coordination to altered deacetylation chemistry.
abstract_zh: 硫化氢（H(2)S）是一种气体信号分子，其对蛋白质功能的非共价效应仍未被完全理解。在此，我们表明H(2)S衍生的硫物种与组蛋白去乙酰化酶6（HDAC6）的催化Zn(2)(+)中心结合，并在特定条件下增强去乙酰化酶活性。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟支持HS(-)进入CD2活性位点通道，而表面等离子体共振和锌耗竭实验支持可逆的、锌依赖性的结合。量子化学计算支持一种化学上可行的硫相关去乙酰化途径，该途径生成硫代乙酸，我们在无细胞反应、培养细胞、小鼠组织和人血清中检测到该物质。冷冻电镜 (cryo-electron microscopy) 定义了人HDAC6催化结构域的串联组织，并揭示了不同的CD1和CD2通道结构。HDAC6缺失削弱H(2)S诱导的内皮迁移和血管生成，且CD2是这些反应所必需的。这些发现支持HDAC6作为H(2)S响应的Zn(2)(+)依赖性去乙酰化酶，并将锌-硫配位与改变的去乙酰化化学联系起来。
